_about: Public-domain George Rawlinson, Camden Professor of Ancient History at Oxford and Canon of Canterbury, for the Word Hoard, his books on Scripture and religion: The Historical Evidences of the Truth of the Scripture Records (his Bampton Lectures), The Contrasts of Christianity with Heathen and Jewish Systems, St. Paul in Damascus and Arabia, The Religions of the Ancient World, Egypt and Babylon from Scripture and Profane Sources, Biblical Topography, The Testimony of the Truth of Scripture, and his lives of Moses, Isaac and Jacob, Ezra and Nehemiah, and the Kings of Israel and Judah. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 131 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

rawlinson-historical-evidences: The historical evidences of the truth of the Scripture records, stated anew, with special reference to the doubts and discvoveries of modern times : in eight lectures, delivered in the Oxford University pulpit (London : John Murray, 1859)
rawlinson-contrasts: The contrasts of Christianity with Heathen and Jewish systems : or, Nine sermons preached before the University of Oxford on various occasions (London : Longman, Green, Longman and Roberts, 1861)
rawlinson-st-paul-damascus: The heathen world and Saint Paul: Saint Paul in Damascus and Arabia (catalogued 1877)
rawlinson-religions-ancient-world: Religions of the ancient world, including Egypt, Assyria, and Babylonia, Persia, India, Phoenicia, Etruria, Greece, Rome (London, Relig. Tract Society, 1880)
rawlinson-egypt-babylon: Egypt and Babylon : from Scripture and profane sources (London : Hodder [and] Stoughton, 1885)
rawlinson-truth-of-scripture: The testimony of the truth of scripture : historical illustrations of the Old Testament, gathered from ancient records, monuments and inscriptions by George Rawlinson ; with additions by Horatio B. Hackett and a preface by H.L. Hastings (Boston : H.L. Hastings, 1898)
rawlinson-moses: Moses : his life and times (New York : A.D.F. Randolph, 1887)
rawlinson-isaac-jacob: Isaac and Jacob: their lives and times (New York, Fleming H. Revell Co, [189)
rawlinson-ezra-nehemiah: Ezra and Nehemiah: their lives and times (New York, F.H. Revell Co, [189)
rawlinson-kings-israel-judah: The kings of Israel and Judah (New York : A.D.F. Randolph, 1889)
